description: Welcome to Sentimental Sentinels, where art meets science, humour meets logic! We are a team of four high schoolers, immersed in science and enthralled by life. We are exploring humanity's most iconic abandoned space hardware left behind on the Moon and Mars. Through our interactive archival guide led by Cosmic Commanders, Nebula and Orion, we bridge technical engineering specs with poignant, long-lasting legacy of humanity's mechanical pioneers. Built with curiosity and a whole lot of heart!
summary: Team Sentimental Sentinels made an interactive website named 'Silent Sentinels: The Rovers that Refused to Die' to narrate the story of the NASA equipment left behind on Moon and Mars. We addressed the challenge in a humorous way as well as providing rigorous data about each rocket through our website. It is important because people who are interested in space exploration must know about the humanity's greatest achievements and space pioneers before engaging in new launches.
details: Silent Rovers that Refused to Die is an interactive digital museum that brings NASA’s discarded lunar and Martian hardware—such as historic landers and rovers like Apollo 11 and Opportunity—back to life. The platform works by combining verified NASA Space Science Data Coordinated Archive logs and exact landing coordinates with immersive narrative design and a synchronized 32-second video trailer. Developed entirely using Canva for web design, presentation layouts, and digital publishing, the project requires zero downloads, offering complete cross-device accessibility. Its primary benefits include zero-barrier learning and scientific accuracy, while its intended impact is to inspire students and educators worldwide by transforming cold technical telemetry into an emotional historical heritage. The project is highly creative because it reimagines space debris as cultural monuments through storytelling rather than traditional data logging. Finally, the team carefully considered equity of access, scientific integrity, and low-bandwidth/offline usability to ensure a seamless, engaging experience for all users.
